import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = fast_pow(base, n // 2)
    ans = 0
    for x in res:
        ans = (ans + x * x) % MOD
    print(ans)

def fast_pow(base, exp):
    if exp == 1:
        return base[:]
    if exp & 1:
        return multiply_precise(base, fast_pow(base, exp - 1))
    half = fast_pow(base, exp >> 1)
    return multiply_precise(half, half)

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    rev = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def transform(inv):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.rev[0] = 0
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                g = 0
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    g = (i.bit_length() - 1)
                FFT.rev[i] = FFT.rev[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - g))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                c = math.cos(angle)
                s = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    idx = p3 + (j - p2) * 2
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * c - FFT.wI[j] * s
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * s + FFT.wI[j] * c

        for i in range(FFT.n):
            r = FFT.rev[i]
            if i < r:
                FFT.aR[i], FFT.aR[r] = FFT.aR[r], FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aI[i], FFT.aI[r] = FFT.aI[r], FFT.aI[i]
        
        if inv:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                wIdx = len_val
                for j in range(i + len_val, i + 2 * len_val):
                    tr = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wIdx] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wIdx]
                    ti = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wIdx] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wIdx]
                    wIdx += 1
                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tr
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - ti
                    FFT.aR[i] += tr
                    FFT.aI[i] += ti
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(a, b):
        la = len(a)
        lb = len(b)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < la + lb - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = a[i] if i < la else 0.0
            FFT.aI[i] = b[i] if i < lb else 0.0
        
        FFT.transform(False)
        FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
        FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
        scale = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n // 2 + 1):
            r1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            i1 = 2 * FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            r2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            i2 = -2 * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            nr = -i1 + i2
            ni = r1 - r2
            FFT.aR[i] = nr * scale
            FFT.aI[i] = ni * scale
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.transform(True)
        
        res = [0] * (la + lb - 1)
        for i in range(len(res)):
            res[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        return res

    @staticmethod
    def multiply_precise(a, b):
        sqrt_mod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        al = [x % sqrt_mod for x in a]
        ah = [x // sqrt_mod for x in a]
        bl = [x % sqrt_mod for x in b]
        bh = [x // sqrt_mod for x in b]
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(al, bl)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(al, bh)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(ah, bl)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(ah, bh)
        
        res = [0] * len(r11)
        sqrt_mod_sq = (sqrt_mod * sqrt_mod) % MOD
        for i in range(len(res)):
            t1 = sqrt_mod_sq * r22[i] % MOD
            t2 = sqrt_mod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD
            res[i] = (t1 + t2 + r11[i]) % MOD
        return res

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
